The '''warped sceptre''' is a [[powered staff]] requiring 62 [[Magic]] to wield, available as a drop from [[Warped Terrorbird|warped terrorbird]]s or [[Warped Tortoise|warped tortoise]]s with level 56 [[Slayer]]. Like most powered staves, it is only tradeable when it is fully uncharged.

Its cast speed gives it an improved damage output compared to the [[Iban's staff]] (at 81 or higher Magic), but less than the [[trident of the seas]]. This is particularly useful for midgame [[Ironman Mode|ironmen players]] who are unable to kill [[Cave kraken]]s. Additionally, the fact that the runes it uses are stored within the staff makes it useful over the Iban's staff (which doesn't store runes) when inventory slots are scarce. 

On death in the wilderness, if you have the sceptre as one of your protected items, it will not lose charges. The built-in spell cannot be used against other players in the wilderness. 

[[File:Warped sceptre spell.gif|thumb|250px|A player using the warped sceptre's built in spell.]]

==Charging==
To use the sceptre's magic spell, it must be charged with [[earth rune|earth]] and [[chaos rune]]s, holding up to 20,000 charges when fully charged. 

Each cast requires 2 chaos runes and 5 earth runes, costing {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Chaos rune|2}}+{{GEP|Earth rune|5}}|c}} per cast. To fully charge a warped sceptre from empty to its maximum capacity of 20,000 charges, you need 40,000 chaos runes and 100,000 earth runes. 

Players can configure the charges while the sceptre is in their bank by right-clicking on Configure-Charges, as long as players have the required materials. Uncharging the sceptre grants all the runes back. Casting continuously results in 25 casts a minute up to 1,500 casts per hour.

==Maximum hit==
The base [[Maximum Magic hit|maximum hit]] dealt by the sceptre is dependent on the player's current [[Magic]] level, starting at 16 with level 62, up to a maximum of 24 at level 99.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1701910078675157295|date=13 September 2023|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/105162|archivedate=13 September 2023|quote=Interpolates linearly between 16 at level 62 and 24 at level 99 (and higher for visible Magic boosts).}} Both magic damage bonuses and visible stat boosts will modify the max hit of the spell; likewise, stat-reductions will lower the damage. Invisible boosts, such as from the sceptre's attack styles, do not affect the max hit.

<math>\begin{align}
\text{Max Hit} &= \left\lfloor \frac{8(\text{Magic Level}) + 96}{37} \right\rfloor
\end{align}</math>
